items.stem: Which TWO-part test determines the classification of a financial asset under IFRS 9?

options.text: The business model test and the SPPI contractual cash flow test
options.rationale: Correct: classification depends on the business model and whether cash flows are solely principal and interest.

options.text: The historical cost test and the market value test
options.rationale: These are not the IFRS 9 classification tests.

options.text: The majority-ownership test and the control test
options.rationale: Those relate to consolidation, not IFRS 9 classification.

options.text: The incurred-loss test and the fair-value test
options.rationale: Incurred loss is the superseded IAS 39 approach.

items.explanation: Correct: classification depends on the business model and whether cash flows are solely principal and interest.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about the IFRS 9 expected credit loss model are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Losses are recognised before a default occurs
options.rationale: Correct: ECL is forward-looking and recognised ahead of actual default.

options.text: A significant increase in credit risk moves an exposure to lifetime ECL
options.rationale: Correct: Stage 2 (and 3) require lifetime ECL after a significant increase in credit risk.

options.text: ECL is only recognised once a loan has defaulted
options.rationale: That is the old incurred-loss approach IFRS 9 replaced.

items.explanation: Correct: ECL is forward-looking and recognised ahead of actual default.

items.stem: In an ECL calculation, what does LGD represent?

options.text: Loss given default: the proportion of exposure expected to be lost if default occurs
options.rationale: Correct: LGD is the share of exposure not recovered after default.

options.text: The probability that a borrower defaults
options.rationale: That is PD, probability of default.

options.text: The total exposure at the time of default
options.rationale: That is EAD, exposure at default.

options.text: The discount rate used for cash flows
options.rationale: The discount rate is a separate input, not LGD.

items.explanation: Correct: LGD is the share of exposure not recovered after default.
